skills.name: seedance-prompt-optimizer
skills.title: Seedance prompts
skills.description: Use the selected Seedance capability for request fields, task types, duration, resolution, references and audio flags. The accompanying upstream guides are creative references; their platform limits and prices are not the HolyCrab API contract. User constraints and current CLI capabilities take precedence.

skills.name: h3-prompt-writing
skills.title: H3 prompts
skills.description: Identify the supported input mode using the installed H3/H3 Max capability. Read h3/base-en.txt for text or keyframe composition, or h3/ref-en.txt for full-reference rewriting. Preserve structured prompt sections and stable reference labels. Dialogue and visible scene text stay in the requested language.
